description.value: Woking Dragon is a family-owned Chinese restaurant operating since 2003, offering modern western-style Chinese cuisine across three Lower Mainland locations including Willoughby Town Centre in Langley. The restaurant has earned recognition as a favourite Chinese food destination in the Tri-Cities market. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect a sit-down meal with online ordering and takeout options available.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 58m; bollard (2 spaces) at 67m; bollard (2 spaces) at 85m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Woking Dragon is a real, open Chinese restaurant with a Langley location (phone 604 546 1825) and multiple other BC locations, family owned since 2003. The 'Order Now' online ordering buttons confirm takeout is available, and the website explicitly states 'Some menu items are able to be made Vegan & Gluten-Free.' No evidence exists on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
